description: Adaptive Period Picker is a date-range slicer whose calendar grid reshapes itself to match the granularity you pick — day view, week numbers, month grid, quarter/semester/year blocks — with a real, cross-page-synced filter, not just a display. Choose popup or always-visible inline layout, immediate or confirm-to-apply behavior, configurable shortcuts (Today, MTD, QTD, YTD, and more), and an optional Granularity Column for a fully data-driven granularity switcher. Includes tooltips, keyboard navigation, right-click context menu, and high-contrast support.
